snippet.title: The Black Knight - Forgotten Flash Games
snippet.description:
This "one-click" flash game was released in 2005 by ArcadeTown and Brain Jam Studios. ArcadeTown still exists today, and has some sort of game launcher you can download with some generic looking titles. I have some fond memories of playing Black Knight on Miniclip, although I never got too far. Interestingly, if you download the SWF and resize the game manually, you can actually see which items you have, as well as oncoming and offgoing targets. That would be a very easy way to increase your score in the long-run, although it ends up looking a bit weird (I didn't do that here).


Yes, I know you are technically supposed to hit them with a normal swing once and then "go medieval". I figured that out after my playthrough. It's definitely possible to go a bit higher in levels, though almost certainly impossible to "go infinite". 


Thanks for watching.
